definitions.explanation: Engineering work involving the construction of roads, bridges, dams, and other infrastructure. Also refers broadly to construction and earthwork.

examples.japanese: {土木|どぼく}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The civil engineering work has started.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{土木|どぼく}⟦{工学|こうがく}→工学：04862_kougaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{専攻|せんこう}→専攻：01587_senkou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He is majoring in civil engineering at university.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧や⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{復旧|ふっきゅう}→復旧：07521_fukkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大規模|だいきぼ}→大規模：12185_daikibo⟧な{土木|どぼく}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: After the earthquake, large-scale civil engineering work was carried out to restore roads and bridges.

notes:
Composed of {土|ど} (earth, soil) + {木|ぼく} (wood, timber) — the two fundamental materials of traditional construction. In modern usage, it refers specifically to civil engineering as opposed to building construction (⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土木|どぼく}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ (civil engineering work, construction work)
- {土木|どぼく}⟦{工学|こうがく}→工学：04862_kougaku⟧ (civil engineering as an academic discipline)
- {土木|どぼく}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ (construction labor)
- {土木|どぼく}⟦{技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}→技術者：17049_gijutsusha⟧ (civil engineer)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧ — architecture, building construction (focuses on buildings)
- ⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧ — construction (broader term covering both civil engineering and building)
- ⟦インフラ→インフラ：09898_infura⟧ — infrastructure (loanword, refers to the completed systems rather than the engineering work)
